args.body: Hi Dora! I visited your website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some feedback. It's a nice personal website that clearly introduces you and makes it easy to get in touch via email. It's simple and straightforward, which I appreciate. If you'd like to make it more engaging, you could add a bit more about yourself — your interests, work, or projects — and maybe some photos or links to things you've been working on. Keep it up the good work!

Hi Eve! I visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. It's a lovely, welcoming introduction to your blog, and I love that you share your passion for hiking — it gives readers an immediate sense of who you are and what your blog is about. To make it even more compelling, you could add some recent hiking posts, photos from your adventures, or trail recommendations, so visitors have a reason to come back and explore more. A great start — I look forward to reading more!
